Type: drop-leaf storage dining table
Use: small-space dining, extra surface, storage; dining room, kitchen, small apartment
Style: mid-century modern, rustic, contemporary
Materials: solid wood, chevron veneer leaves, brass bar pulls
Colors: warm medium brown wood, brass
Shape: narrow cabinet body with one drawer and one door, two fold-down leaves, square block legs, compact when folded, solid and boxy
Feel: warm, practical, cozy
Goes with: cream walls, brass accents, woven textiles; mid-century or small modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Alejandra Unfinished Wood Kitchen Dining Table, Storage, Brown
product.description: This beautiful drop-leaf table is the ultimate space saver and storage solution. Two leaves can extend out for meals with your friends and family, or fold down to save space. Three drawers provide room for eating utensils and other items. 29"L x 19-60"W x 30"H Hardwoods with acacia veneer in rustic butterscotch A transitional style that can blend with farmhouse, traditional or industrial styles Leaves fold in when not in use to save space. This piece could also be used as a desk. No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
